review_lead: The keys and moves you miss most often or reach slowest. One drill puts them together.
review_needs_level: Choose your starting level on Today first: without it there is nothing to compare against.
review_mode_words: Real words from open keys, each holding a weak spot.
review_mode_moves: Stage 1 moves. Words arrive once Stage 2 opens.
review_empty_fresh: Do a few exercises on the Path. A key or a move is judged only after five presses, so what shows up here is what you really stumble on.
review_empty_clean: Everything in your recent attempts is accurate and even. Carry on with the next action; we keep watching.
review_map_intro: Every key over your recent attempts. The deeper the red, the worse.
review_rhythm_intro: Mean interval between presses in each attempt, and its spread. A narrow band is an even rhythm.
review_rhythm_summary: Last {count} attempts: {ms} ms between presses on average, rhythm consistency {rhythm}%.
review_rhythm_empty: Rhythm appears after your first completed attempt.
review_drill_goal_words: Real words holding your weak spots: {spots}.
review_drill_locked: This drill cannot be built from your open keys now. Go back to Review for a fresh one.
review_outcome_intro: Each weak spot: before the drill (recent attempts) and in this drill.
